alkylation_reagent.evidence: alkylated by Iodoacetamide (Thermo Scientific) at 37°C for 30 minutes.

cleavage_agent.evidence: incubated overnight at 37°C with 2 μg of sequence-grade trypsin (Promega) in 200 μL of 10 mM CaCl2/100mM TEAB.

enrichment_method.evidence: Cooled samples were diluted into 5mL of PBS containing 100μL of washed Streptavidin-Agarose Resin (Thermo Scientific) and rotated overnight at 4°C.

fragmentation_method.evidence: MS2 analysis included the isolation of precursor ions (isolation window 2 m/z) and HCD (collision energy 30%).

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: The spray voltage was set to 2.1 kV.

labeling.evidence: inferred: Peptides were resuspended in 100 µL of 200 mM EPPS buffer, pH = 8.5 (Thermo Scientific) with 30 % acetonitrile and incubated with TMTsixplex (Thermo Scientific) isobaric tags (20 µg/µL) for 90 minutes at room temperature.
